articles.title: Rupee likely shielded by RBI intervention as oil surges
articles.content: The Indian rupee remained largely unchanged on Thursday.  Higher oil prices and central bank actions influenced its movement.  Global tensions in the Red Sea and strikes on Iran escalated oil prices.  These rising energy costs pose a significant risk to India's economy.  The rupee's stability depends on continued foreign investment in government debt.

articles.title: Oil prices scorch Indian bonds; rising Treasury yields add to pressure
articles.content: Indian government bonds declined early Thursday as Middle East tensions escalated. Crude oil prices neared $100 a barrel, and U.S. Treasury yields also rose. Higher oil prices threaten to revive inflation pressures and weaken the Indian rupee. This situation could significantly impact energy-intensive industries and economies. India imports nearly ninety percent of its crude oil requirements.

articles.title: Global Market: Macquarie names Greg Ward as next CEO, signalling leadership continuity
articles.content: Macquarie Group has appointed Greg Ward as its new chief executive officer. Investors view this leadership transition as a vote of confidence in the company. This internal succession reflects the company's strong market position and stable strategy.

articles.title: Adani Green shares tumble 5% after Q1 results. Here’s why Bernstein has an Underperform rating
articles.content: Adani Green Energy shares fell on Thursday despite reporting a strong Q1 FY27 performance, with consolidated net profit rising 19% year-on-year to Rs 845 crore and revenue increasing 16% to Rs 4,663 crore. Revenue from power supply jumped 29%, supported by robust operational performance and a 27% increase in operational capacity to 20,142 MW.

articles.title: Tesla earnings disappoint Wall Street as Elon Musk’s AI push, pivot beyond cars hurt profits
articles.content: Tesla's second quarter earnings missed profit estimates for the first time in over two years. The company reported negative free cash flow as AI and robotics investments accelerated significantly. Higher operating expenses and lower average selling prices also impacted Tesla's profitability. Despite record vehicle deliveries, investors expressed concern over the increased cash burn. Tesla shares experienced a decline following the announcement of these financial results.

articles.title: Q1 Results Live Updates: Infosys, IndiGo among key companies to announce Q1FY27 results today
Alphabet's quarterly earnings beat Wall Street estimates, but here's what is spooking investors
articles.content: Alphabet announced strong second-quarter earnings, but its shares declined significantly. The company plans to substantially increase its capital expenditures for artificial intelligence. This massive spending hike comes as Google Cloud revenue saw substantial growth. CEO Sundar Pichai addressed concerns about Google's competitive position in the AI race. Investors and analysts are weighing the potential returns of this significant AI investment.

articles.title: Up to 451% return in 6 months! 11 smallcap stocks turn multibaggers as FIIs raise stakes for 2 straight quarters
articles.content: 11 smallcaps have at least doubled in six months, led by Sterlite Technologies' 451% jump, as FIIs raised stakes across the March and June 2026 quarters. The parallel rise signals selective conviction, but analysts warn the sharp rerating leaves little room for earnings misses.

articles.title: Dr Reddy’s shares crack 9% after weak Q1; these 3 brokerages slash their target prices
articles.content: Dr Reddy’s shares plunged 9% on Thursday after the drugmaker reported a weak Q1 FY27 performance, with net profit tumbling 69% year-on-year to Rs 443 crore and revenue declining 6% to Rs 8,071 crore. Earnings were hit by a Rs 240 crore semaglutide API-related impact, including inventory provisions, while higher solvent and freight costs due to the Middle East conflict further squeezed EBITDA margins.

articles.title: US Stock Market: CME shares jump 6% after Q2 profit beats estimates; strong hedging demand boosts results
articles.content: CME Group shares surged after reporting strong second-quarter earnings which exceeded analyst estimates. Resilient hedging demand and increased equity index trading volumes fueled this positive financial performance. Despite softer trading in some areas, the company's data services business also showed significant revenue growth. Investor concerns about perpetual futures persist, though some analysts see long-term insignificance. The company is also preparing for a leadership transition with a new CEO appointed.

articles.title: IndusInd Bank shares fall 5% despite 72% YoY Q1 profit surge. Why analysts remain bullish?
articles.content: IndusInd Bank shares fell despite reporting a 72% year-on-year jump in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 1,037 crore and brokerages raising target prices. articles.title: Sensex drops over 300 points, Nifty below 23,950 as market falls for 4th day on rising Iran-US tensions. What’s ahead?
articles.content: Indian stock markets extended losses for a fourth session on Thursday. Sensex and Nifty declined as oil prices surged following US strikes on Iran. This situation presents opportunities for long-term investors to accumulate quality stocks.

articles.title: Global Market: South Korea's Q2 GDP beats estimates on chip exports; semiconductor stocks in focus
articles.content: South Korea's GDP expanded 0.6% in the second quarter. Robust semiconductor exports offset weakness in construction investment, reinforcing optimism for the technology sector. The Bank of Korea expects annual growth around three percent this year. Further interest rate hikes are anticipated due to elevated inflation and growth. This data supports sentiment towards South Korean export-oriented companies.

articles.title: ICICI Bank sets initial guidance for first dollar bond in nearly 9 years, bankers say
articles.content: ICICI Bank is returning to dollar debt markets after nine years.  The lender seeks to raise at least $500 million through a five-year bond.  This issuance leverages the central bank's lower-cost hedging facility.  Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.  The offering will be rated Baa3 by Moody's and BBB by S&P.

articles.title: US Stock Market: Tesla-SpaceX merger speculation grows after Musk leaves door open
articles.content: Speculation about a Tesla and SpaceX merger has intensified recently. Elon Musk did not rule out combining his companies during an earnings call. However, significant regulatory and governance hurdles remain for any potential deal.

articles.title: Kospi jumps 9% in 3 days after big crash. Is South Korea's stock market heading for another rally?
articles.content: South Korea's Kospi surged 4% on Thursday, extending gains for a third straight session, as stronger-than-expected economic growth and robust AI spending plans from US tech giants boosted chip stocks. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix climbed up to 6%, driving the benchmark higher after GDP expanded 0.6% in the April-June quarter, beating forecasts.
